title: A minimal prime of a Noetherian ring is an associated prime of the ring
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $\mathfrak p\subset R$ be a minimal prime ideal of $R$ (a prime ideal containing no strictly smaller prime ideal). Then $\mathfrak p$ is an associated prime of $R$: there is an element $z\in R$ whose annihilator $\operatorname{Ann}_R(z)=\{a\in R: az=0\}$ equals $\mathfrak p$.
